title: Target Is Now Buying Your Unwanted Gift Cards - Newsy
description: The retailer has announced a new program that lets shoppers trade in gift cards from other stores for a Target gift card. asr.full_text: Pretty much everyone has received a gift card to a store they just never shop at. But Target might have a way to make that card actually worth something to you. The retailer is exchanging unwanted gift cards for in-store credit at a reduced rate. Unfortunately, the loss isn't small. For instance, Fortune found a 100 dollar Walmart gift card traded in for an 85 dollar Target card. Still, it's probably better than letting a useless gift card take up space in your wallet forever. Target's program is far from a new concept. Sites like Giftcartgranny.com and Cardpoll.com offer the same service and, depending on the card, may actually offer a more even exchange than Target. But, on the other hand, Target offers the convenience of being able to go to a store and immediately get credit to spend. The National Retail Federation estimates $25.9 billion in gift card spending in 2015.

visual.observation: Screenshots show gift-card exchange websites offering discounted gift cards for purchase and cash-back percentages for selling unwanted gift cards, with additional purchase-guarantee and referral-benefit text visible.
visual.context: Commercial website interfaces are shown within a newsy-branded video; whether the segment is promoting or reporting on these services is unclear.
visual.potential_relevance: The visible return and discount claims are directly linked to requesting viewers to buy or sell gift cards through the displayed exchange services, creating a reward/payment relationship that may merit contextual review.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not establish whether any offer is genuine, whether a transaction occurred, who would receive payment, or whether the websites were being endorsed, investigated, or merely shown as examples.

visual_context_notes.observation: The frames visibly carry the newsy watermark, and the gift-card exchange pages include ordinary site navigation for buying, selling, balance checking, and account access.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a news-style report about Target's gift-card exchange program and compares it with other gift-card exchange services. The retail footage, Newsy branding, and Newsy Business end card support a reporting context, while the video does not establish an endorsement of the external sites or a harmful outcome.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: Ordinary retail commerce and gift-card exchange services are the central subject. The evidence describes exchanging unwanted gift cards for in-store credit and compares other services offering the same type of exchange.
